definitions.explanation: The specialized stage on which Noh theater is performed, featuring a roofed square platform and a bridge-like walkway for entrances.

examples.japanese: {能舞台|のうぶたい}⟦で→で：00502_de⟧⟦{演|えん}じる→演じる：13330_enjiru⟧。
examples.english: To perform on a Noh stage.

examples.japanese: ⟦この→この：00962_kono⟧⟦{神社|じんじゃ}→神社：01620_jinja⟧⟦に→に：00314_ni⟧⟦は→は：00079_ha⟧⟦{古|ふる}い→古い：00488_furui⟧{能舞台|のうぶたい}⟦が→が：00051_ga⟧⟦ある→ある：00006_aru⟧。
examples.english: This shrine has an old Noh stage.

examples.japanese: {能舞台|のうぶたい}⟦は→は：00079_ha⟧⟦{屋根|やね}→屋根：02264_yane⟧⟦と→と：00512_to⟧⟦{橋|はし}→橋：02163_hashi⟧がかり⟦を→を：00422_wo⟧⟦{備|そな}えた→備える：02125_sonaeru⟧⟦{独特|どくとく}→独特：01656_dokutoku⟧⟦の→の：09472_no⟧⟦{構造|こうぞう}→構造：02730_kouzou⟧⟦を→を：00422_wo⟧⟦している→する：00392_suru⟧。
examples.english: A Noh stage has a distinctive structure with a roof and a bridgeway.

notes:
The stage used for ⟦{能|のう}→能：01927_nou⟧ (Noh theater). Its standard features include a roof even when indoors, a square main platform, and the ⟦{橋|はし}→橋：02163_hashi⟧がかり walkway by which performers enter.

COMMON COLLOCATIONS:
- {能舞台|のうぶたい}⟦に→に：00314_ni⟧⟦{立|た}つ→立つ：00758_tatsu⟧: to stand on a Noh stage
- {能舞台|のうぶたい}⟦で→で：00502_de⟧⟦{舞|ま}う→舞う：04573_mau⟧: to dance on a Noh stage

SIMILAR WORDS:
- ⟦{舞台|ぶたい}→舞台：03606_butai⟧: stage — the general word for any performance stage
- ⟦{能面|のうめん}→能面：27782_noumen⟧: Noh mask — another core element of Noh performance
